title: Go to CapCut Creator Studio, select Seedance 2.5, and use it to generate more…
content: Go to CapCut Creator Studio, select Seedance 2.5, and use it to generate more emotionally dialed character performances (expressions/emotions) instead of defaulting to fight scenes/aerial shots/dragons.
tips: Go to CapCut Creator Studio, select Seedance 2.5, and use it to generate more emotionally dialed character performances (expressions/emotions) instead of defaulting to fight scenes/aerial shots/dragons.

es.content: Ve a CapCut Creator Studio, selecciona Seedance 2.5 y úsalo para generar interpretaciones de personajes con una carga emocional más afinada (expresiones/emociones), en lugar de recurrir por defecto a escenas de lucha, tomas aéreas o dragones.

fr.content: Accédez à CapCut Creator Studio, sélectionnez Seedance 2.5 et utilisez-le pour générer des performances de personnages plus chargées en émotion (expressions/émotions), au lieu de vous rabattre par défaut sur des scènes de combat, des plans aériens ou des dragons.

ja.content: CapCut Creator Studioに移動し、Seedance 2.5を選択して、デフォルトの戦闘シーン／空撮／ドラゴンではなく、より感情表現の豊かなキャラクターパフォーマンス（表情・感情）を生成するために使ってください。

ko.content: CapCut Creator Studio로 이동해 Seedance 2.5를 선택한 다음, 기본적으로 전투 장면/항공 샷/드래곤에만 의존하지 말고, 이를 활용해 더 감정적으로 섬세한 캐릭터 연기(표정/감정)를 생성하세요.

pt.content: Acesse o CapCut Creator Studio, selecione o Seedance 2.5 e use-o para gerar performances de personagens mais carregadas de emoção (expressões/emocionalidade), em vez de recorrer automaticamente a cenas de luta, tomadas aéreas ou dragões.

zh.content: 前往 CapCut Creator Studio，选择 Seedance 2.5，并用它来生成更具情感张力的角色表演（表情/情绪），而不是默认生成打斗场景/航拍镜头/巨龙。
